content: Connect your own provider API key to run a model on it. Your key takes precedence: requests to that model go to the provider directly rather than through OpenRouter. The provider bills you for the tokens used, and only the {{percent}}% service fee on that amount is charged to your wallet.

comment.text: Description at the top of the BYOK tab of the AI settings page explaining that a connected provider key is used instead of OpenRouter. {{percent}} is a number (the service fee percentage) followed by a literal % sign; OpenRouter is a product name and stays untranslated.
